headline: Enphase returns to profit as tariff refunds boost margins
summary_short: Enphase's Q2 2026 revenue fell 19.6% y/y to $291.9M on lower IQ Battery shipments and pricing, but gross margin jumped to 60.0% on $45.4M of IEEPA tariff refunds, driving net income to $36.1M ($0.27 diluted EPS) from a $7.4M net loss in Q1 2026.
summary_long: Second-quarter net revenues fell 19.6% y/y to $291.9M, driven by a 40% drop in IQ Battery MWh shipped and lower product pricing, partly offset by a 4% rise in microinverter units sold. U.S. revenue fell on the expired Section 25D residential tax credit; European revenue fell on soft demand and delayed purchasing. Gross margin rose to 60.0% (+13.1ppt y/y) largely from $45.4M of IEEPA tariff refunds, partially offset by lower IQ Battery volume absorption. Operating expenses fell on 2026 restructuring savings. Net income was $36.1M (EPS $0.27), rebounding from a $7.4M net loss in Q1 2026. No new guidance was issued in this 10-Q. Cash and marketable securities fell $592.5M y/y after the $632.5M payoff of the Notes due 2026.
